items.description: Signed S Dan Jackson to the practice squad.

Waived DE Tanoh Kpassagnon.
Elevated FB Nate Carter and TE John FitzPatrick from the practice squad.
Signed DT Payton Page to the practice squad.

Placed DL Skyler Gill-Howard on injured reserve. Elevated DE Anthony Lucas from the practice squad to the active roster.

Signed P Jack Browning from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed DE Max Llewellyn to the practice squad.

Designated DT T'Vondre Sweat to return from injured reserve.
Elevated LB Mason Reiger and DB Cole Wisniewski from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed DT Gabe Hall from the practice squad to the active roster.
